Max cost per order: 5 000 kr ÷ 300 = 17 kr.
Views: 5 000 kr at a 115 kr CPM ≈ 43 000 (one person may see the ad more than once).
Needed: 300 orders from 43 000 views ≈ 1 in 150.
Usual range is a rough US-based estimate. Put in your own CPM under “I know my own numbers”.

a2.text: The creator costs 3 900 kr more than the AI version. Across 2 campaigns, the human version needs 16 more orders than the AI version to pay for itself, about 8 per campaign.
a2.how:
3 900 kr extra ÷ 250 kr per order = 16 orders (rounded up).
Spread over 2 campaigns: about 8 each.
Uses the full price. If you know your margin per order, use that instead: the number goes up.
A longer-term brand effect for human work is cited in research but kept out of this number (low confidence).
